3.t: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?

4.t: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!

5.t: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!

6.t: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;

7.t: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!

8.t: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?

9.t: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.

10.t: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.

11.t: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),

12.t: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.

13.t: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,

14.t: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-

15.t: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.

16.t: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,

17.t: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.

18.t: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.

19.t: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!

20.t: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"

21.t: And he will be in a life of Bliss,

23.t: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.

24.t: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"

25.t: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!

26.t: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!

27.t: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!

28.t: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!

30.t: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,

31.t: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.

32.t: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!

33.t: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.

34.t: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!

35.t: "So no friend hath he here this Day.

36.t: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,

37.t: "Which none do eat but those in sin."

38.t: So I do call to witness what ye see,

40.t: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;

41.t: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!

42.t: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.

43.t: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.

44.t: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,

45.t: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,

46.t: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:

47.t: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).

48.t: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.

49.t: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).

50.t: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.

51.t: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.

52.t: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
